name: @projexlight/connector-microsoft365
summary: Microsoft 365 connector: OAuth install at tenant scope, sync OneDrive / SharePoint files, Outlook calendar + mail, Teams messages. The enterprise IT integration — large tenants on M365 use this for unified search, audit, + ChatOps. Composes with sdk-evidence for file-archive workflows + sdk-notification for Teams-routed alerts.

events.name: connector-microsoft365.mail.sent.v1
events.description: Outbound mail send via Graph API.

hooks.name: installConnector
hooks.description: Tenant-scoped OAuth install; stores refresh token + records tenant_id.

hooks.name: postTeamsMessage
hooks.description: Post a message to a Teams channel (replaces / augments connector-slack for M365 shops).

hooks.name: sendMail
hooks.description: Send mail via Graph API (audited; recipient + persona pinned).

scenarios.title: Enterprise IT installs M365 connector at tenant scope
scenarios.when_to_use: Admin grants admin-consent for tenant-wide scopes (Files.Read.All, Calendar.Read, Teams.Send).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Install row + vault-wrapped refresh token. Initial delta-token captured.

scenarios.title: Daily delta-sync of OneDrive folder into the file cache
scenarios.when_to_use: Compliance ask: every file in the 'Contracts' SharePoint site indexed locally for sdk-search + sdk-evidence archive.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Changed files synced; metadata cached + bytes optionally ingested into sdk-media. .drive_item.synced.v1 per file.

scenarios.title: Storm alert routes to Teams channel
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on notification.message.sent.v1 with channel: { kind: 'teams' } — connector formats + posts via Graph API.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message posted to Teams; emits .teams.message.v1. Failures retried (Graph throttles aggressively).

scenarios.title: Send a customer email via Outlook (Graph) for tenant-owned audit trail
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant wants outbound mail to appear in the sender's Outlook Sent folder (not via a generic SMTP relay) for compliance + thread continuity.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Mail sent + appears in sender's Sent. Emits .mail.sent.v1; sdk-audit picks up the chain.

scenarios.title: Calendar webhook updates the encounter row
scenarios.when_to_use: Graph change-notification fires when a meeting moves; we update the linked ProjexCloud encounter so the rep's schedule stays in sync.
scenarios.example_code:
import { handleWebhook } from '@projexlight/connector-microsoft365';
await handleWebhook({ tenant_id, resource: 'calendar', body });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Encounter time updated; emits .calendar.event.v1. Affected reps notified via sdk-notification.

compliance_posture.notes: Refresh tokens vault-wrapped. Tenant-scoped admin-consent OAuth (vs. user-delegated) so service-account access is honored. GCC / GCC-High pinning available for FedRAMP-regulated tenants.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per Outlook mail sent via Graph
